title: Box
description: A polymorphic container with spacing, size, background, radius and shadow shorthands.

wc:minerva-box.summary: Container with spacing, size, background, radius and shadow shorthands.
wc:minerva-box.description: A container with a small set of style shorthands: padding, margin, size, background, radius, shadow, border (`<Box>` of React). The element itself is the box: the shorthands are applied to the host (through `:host` rules of a per-instance stylesheet), so an inline `style` on the element wins over them, as in React. Side attributes win over axis attributes, which win over the all-sides shorthand. Differences from React: no `as` (use the element directly, or give it a `role`); it is `display: block` by default (override with `style`).

properties.name: p
properties.description: Padding on all sides (spacing token or CSS value)

properties.name: m
properties.description: Margin on all sides (spacing token or CSS value such as "auto")

properties.name: w
properties.description: Width: numbers are pixels, strings are CSS lengths

properties.name: h
properties.description: Height: numbers are pixels, strings are CSS lengths

properties.name: bg
properties.description: Background: a surface alias (`bg`, `bg.subtle`, `bg.muted`, `bg.canvas`, `bg.elevated`, `bg.emphasis`) or any CSS background value

properties.name: rounded
properties.description: Border radius: a radius token (none, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, full) or any CSS value

properties.name: boxShadow
properties.description: Box shadow: a shadow token (sm, md, lg, xl) or any CSS value

files.apps/docs/src/docs/pages/box/wc/basic.ht:
<minerva-box p="4" bg="bg.muted" rounded="md">
  Padding from the spacing scale, a surface background and a radius token.
</minerva-box>
<minerva-box
  p="4"
  mt="3"
  rounded="lg"
  box-shadow="md"
  border="1px solid var(--border-color)"
>
  An elevated box with a shadow token and a CSS border.
</minerva-box>

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: The element itself is the box: p, bg, rounded, box-shadow and border are applied to the host.

files.apps/docs/src/docs/pages/box/wc/spacing-:
<minerva-box bg="bg.subtle" p="2" rounded="md">
  <minerva-box bg="bg.muted" px="6" py="2" mb="3" rounded="sm">
    px="6" py="2" mb="3": spacing tokens
  </minerva-box>
  <minerva-box bg="bg.muted" p="12px" mx="auto" w="240" rounded="sm">
    p="12px" mx="auto" w="240": CSS values and pixels
  </minerva-box>
  <minerva-box bg="bg.muted" p="3" mt="3" max-w="60%" min-h="80" rounded="sm">
    max-w="60%" min-h="80"
  </minerva-box>
</minerva-box>

examples.title: Spacing and sizing
examples.description: Numbers select spacing tokens (p="4" is var(--space-4)), other strings are CSS values; sizes (w, h, min-/max-) are pixels or CSS lengths. Side attributes win over axis ones, which win over the all-sides shorthand.

examples.title: Surfaces, radius and shadow
examples.description: bg accepts the surface aliases (bg, bg.subtle, bg.muted, bg.canvas, bg.elevated) or any CSS background; rounded and box-shadow accept tokens or CSS values.
